plan_review.notes: Reviewed plan for pre-exit XP sweep. Key concerns addressed: (1) sweep now XP-specific not all-loot, (2) dedicated target latch to avoid zig-zag, (3) panic-threshold gate not just beeline, (4) correct stair availability checks. plan_divergence: minor — scope narrowed from all-loot to XP-only, panic threshold added.

rounds.notes: No high-confidence bugs, logic errors, or policy violations found. Panic-profile null case correctly handled (computeCollapsePanicProfile returns panic:0/beeline:false for Floor 2). Target latch re-validated and invalidated on all exit paths. Blackboard rebuilt fresh each poll — no cross-frame staleness. Reachability TTL-cached — unlimited radius scan does not re-pay full A* cost per frame. xpOnGroundAtEnd sums the same xpGem.value store used for totalXp accrual. Crash-path and normal-path computations are duplicated but on mutually exclusive branches.
